en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a small European town on a hill, with open fields in the foreground and a winding path leading toward the settlement. The town features clustered houses with pitched roofs and a prominent church with a tall tower and spire dominating the skyline. Trees and hillside vegetation surround the built-up area. The town name "Dohna." is printed in red at the bottom, and a publisher's line appears along the lower edge. A red handwritten number "2281" is written in the upper right corner.
